nodes.title: Ridge
nodes.body: Ridge is a native terminal workbench built on Tauri v2 with a Rust backend and Svelte 5 frontend. It provides independent PTY panes, recursive split layouts, WebGPU terminal rendering, persistent workspaces, editor and Git tooling, search, and local or remote collaboration. Portable domain, terminal, tmux, MCP, and remote logic lives in Tauri-free workspace packages reused by desktop and headless hosts.

nodes.title: Rust Workspace and Build Profiles
nodes.body: The root Cargo workspace defines Ridge Rust members, dependency resolution, and native versus WASM build profiles.

nodes.title: Claude Project Automation
nodes.body: Project-scoped Claude settings and workflows support repository automation; runtime worktree copies are excluded from the semantic graph.

nodes.title: Continuous Integration and Releases
nodes.body: GitHub workflows build, test, publish, and release Ridge artifacts and web surfaces.

nodes.title: Developer MCP Configuration
nodes.body: Repository-local MCP configuration declares development integrations without defining Ridge core behavior.

nodes.title: OpenCode Project Automation
nodes.body: Project-scoped OpenCode configuration supports repository development workflows.

nodes.title: JavaScript Application and Toolchain
nodes.body: The root package manifest defines the Ridge application, workspace dependencies, and development, build, test, packaging, and release commands.

nodes.title: Shared Packages and Portable Cores
nodes.body: Workspace packages provide portable command, terminal, tmux, MCP, remote, CLI, kernel, and split-layout capabilities shared across desktop and headless hosts.

nodes.title: Browser End-to-End Test Configuration
nodes.body: Playwright configuration governs browser-level end-to-end coverage.

nodes.title: pnpm Workspace Boundaries
nodes.body: The pnpm workspace manifest defines JavaScript package membership and controlled dependency build behavior.

nodes.title: Build, Test, and Release Automation
nodes.body: Repository scripts automate development startup, builds, packaging, remote deployment, protocol checks, performance measurement, and end-to-end verification.

nodes.title: Product Website
nodes.body: The static product site documents Ridge, its releases, and its user-facing capabilities.

nodes.title: Svelte Desktop Frontend
nodes.body: The Svelte frontend owns workspace and pane presentation, terminal surfaces, editor and Git experiences, search, settings, and remote collaboration interfaces.

nodes.title: Tauri Desktop Host
nodes.body: The Rust Tauri host owns native commands, PTY and pane engines, filesystem and database services, remote transports, teammate services, tray integration, and desktop lifecycle.

nodes.title: Bundled Static Assets
nodes.body: Static assets provide application branding, fonts, images, and checked-in client resources; generated remote output is excluded.

nodes.title: SvelteKit Application Configuration
nodes.body: SvelteKit configuration defines application compilation and static deployment behavior.

nodes.title: TypeScript Compiler Configuration
nodes.body: TypeScript configuration defines frontend and tooling type-check boundaries.

nodes.title: Desktop Frontend Build Configuration
nodes.body: Vite configuration builds and serves the primary Ridge frontend.

nodes.title: Remote Client Build Configuration
nodes.body: The remote Vite configuration builds Ridge remote client surfaces.

nodes.title: Unit Test Configuration
nodes.body: Vitest configuration governs TypeScript and Svelte unit and integration tests.

nodes.title: Editor Workspace Configuration
nodes.body: VS Code workspace settings provide repository-local development defaults.

nodes.title: Desktop Shell End-to-End Configuration
nodes.body: WebdriverIO configuration governs native desktop shell end-to-end tests.

nodes.title: Frame Performance Test Configuration
nodes.body: WebdriverIO frame configuration governs desktop rendering and frame-time measurements.

nodes.title: Stress and Performance Test Configuration
nodes.body: WebdriverIO performance configuration governs stress and responsiveness measurements.
